paper_metadata.title: Yi: Open Foundation Models by 01.AI
paper_metadata.abstract: We introduce the Yi model family, a series of language and multimodal models that demonstrate strong multi-dimensional capabilities. The Yi model family is based on 6B and 34B pretrained language models, then we extend them to chat models, 200K long context models, depth-upscaled models, and vision-language models. Our base models achieve strong performance on a wide range of benchmarks like MMLU, and our finetuned chat models deliver strong human preference rate on major evaluation platforms like AlpacaEval and Chatbot Arena. Building upon our scalable super-computing infrastructure and the classical transformer architecture, we attribute the performance of Yi models primarily to its data quality resulting from our data-engineering efforts. For pretraining, we construct 3.1 trillion tokens of English and Chinese corpora using a cascaded data deduplication and quality filtering pipeline. For finetuning, we polish a small scale (less than 10K) instruction dataset over multiple iterations such that every single instance has been verified directly by our machine learning engineers. For vision-language, we combine the chat language model with a vision transformer encoder and train the model to align visual representations to the semantic space of the language model. We further extend the context length to 200K through lightweight continual pretraining and demonstrate strong needle-in-a-haystack retrieval performance. We show that extending the depth of the pretrained checkpoint through continual pretraining further improves performance. We believe that given our current results, continuing to scale up model parameters using thoroughly optimized data will lead to even stronger frontier models.

extraction_data.innovation: Grouped-Query Attention (GQA): splits query heads into groups sharing a single key and value head per group, reducing training and inference costs compared to Multi-Head Attention without performance degradation on the 6B model; SwiGLU activation: replaces the standard post-attention layer to reduce activation size from 4h to 8/3h, compensating for parameter reduction from GQA to keep overall parameter count comparable to existing 7B and 34B models; RoPE base frequency adjustment (RoPE ABF) and continued pre-training: adjusts the base frequency of Rotary Position Embedding and continues pre-training on 10B tokens with upsampled long sequences to intrinsically support 200K context windows, demonstrating that modeling longer dependencies is an intrinsic capability released by post-train rather than injected by it; rigorous data cleaning pipeline: integrates learned scorers (perplexity, quality, safety, document coherence), cluster-based semantic filtering, and comprehensive deduplication to produce high-quality bilingual data, outperforming standard heuristic rules especially for Chinese CommonCrawl content.
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Supervised fine-tuning on multi-turn instruction-response pairs, Iterative instruction tuning on small datasets (≤10K samples)
extraction_data.extension: Depth upscaling enhances the 6B model's capacity; continual pretraining on length-upsampled long-context data and multi-document QA synthetic data unlocks 200K context window; CLIP ViT-H/14 vision encoder integrated for multimodal understanding.
extraction_data.research_problem: Open foundation models matching GPT-3.5 quality with cost-effective deployment
extraction_data.application: Language modeling, chatbots, AI-native applications, agents, locally runnable chatbots
extraction_data.finetuning_data: <10K multi-turn instruction-response dialog pairs, open-source prompts, Curated multi-turn instruction-response pairs (<10K)
extraction_data.hardware_description: Multi-cloud GPU cluster, Megatron and DeepSpeed
extraction_data.context_extension_method: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) with adjusted base frequency (RoPE ABF) and continued pre-training on 10B tokens with upsampled long sequences
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training on 3.1T tokens -> continued pre-training on 10B tokens for long context -> Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Model-assisted automated methods: randomly concatenate multiple documents, sample paragraphs, ask a chat model to construct question-answer pairs with recitation/rephrasing of the original paragraph
extraction_data.safety_evaluation_protocol: RAISE full-stack safety engine; safety taxonomy covering environmental, religious, discriminatory, substance abuse, violent, illegal, hate speech, privacy, self-harm, sexual, mental health, cybersecurity; simulated attack prompts
extraction_data.vision_encoder: CLIP ViT-H/14, Vision encoder integrated for vision-language tasks
